title: Amazingly Aromatic Peruvian Chicken Causa Limena
description: A cultured and tender Peruvian dish featuring chicken, clear honey, and a hint of spice, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this diabetic-friendly recipe is made in individual mini cocottes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and place it in individual mini cocottes.
Divide the mashed potatoes among the mini cocottes, topping each with a piece of chicken.
Drizzle the clear honey over the top of each mini cocotte.
Pour the chicken broth into the bottom of each mini cocotte.
Cover the mini cocottes with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
